# DEXPI reference P&ID

`reference_pid.xml` is the reference P&ID published with the DEXPI 2.0.1 specification. The tests use it to check that the validator accepts an official DEXPI file.

Source: <https://dexpi.org/specification/2.0.1/html/appendix/reference_pid.html> (file: `_static/reference_pid.xml`)
